title: Unified framework for asymptotically uniform iterative construction of generalised random graphs with local constraints
summary: We develop a unified framework for constructing combinatorial structures under local constraints. Our approach extends the configuration model for random graphs with a prescribed degree sequence, and covers many special cases, including bipartite graphs, directed graphs, oriented graphs, edge-colored (bipartite) graphs, and (directed) hypergraphs. By reformulating half-edge matching as an independent set problem in an auxiliary graph, we identify 2-uniformity, a property characterising when greedy sampling preserves asymptotic uniformity.
